data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Theophilus, meaning 'beloved of God'. In Christian tradition, Timi is a name of reverence and devotion. The name Timi carries the meaning “Honor to God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Timi usually hope their child will grow to embody honor to god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Timi total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Timi in its various forms has been popular in Christian cultures, particularly in Nigeria and within the Yoruba people. It represents a deep connection to one's faith and heritage. Historically, the name was given to children born into Christian families as a symbol of their embracing the teachings and love of God. Today, it remains a respected and cherished name within those communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Timi is rooted in its meanings of 'beloved of God' and 'favor of God'. This name carries a deep sense of reverence and devotion, reminding those who bear it that they are cherished and favored by the divine. As expressed through the Yoruba tradition and Christian teachings, Timi serves as a constant reminder of the importance of maintaining a strong spiritual connection with God and staying faithful to His love.
